control_equivalence_rule.new: Serial control and optimized plans must preserve an identical obligation_set_hash and identical mandatory quality-gate set before empirical comparison is valid.
control_equivalence_rule.old: Serial control and optimized plans must preserve an identical obligation_set_hash and identical mandatory quality-gate set before empirical comparison is valid.

critical_path_tie_rule.new: Every execution fixture is eligible. Critical-path truth is the set of ALL maximum-total-work paths in the effective DAG after mechanically derived conflict-serialization edges; set equality is required.
critical_path_tie_rule.old: Every execution fixture is eligible. Critical-path truth is the set of ALL maximum-total-work paths in the effective DAG after mechanically derived conflict-serialization edges; set equality is required.

integration_anti_gaming_rule.new: Integration completeness denominator is the fixed 23-source-task universe, never emitted workstream count. Every emitted workstream must identify >=1 source_task_ids, and every source task must be covered.
integration_anti_gaming_rule.old: Integration completeness denominator is the fixed 23-source-task universe, never emitted workstream count. Every emitted workstream must identify >=1 source_task_ids, and every source task must be covered.

missing_data_policy.new: Missing, skipped, malformed, unreconciled, or environment-incomparable evidence is unavailable and cannot count as zero or PASS.
missing_data_policy.old: Missing, skipped, malformed, unreconciled, or environment-incomparable evidence is unavailable and cannot count as zero or PASS.

structural_vs_empirical_rule.new: Synthetic/fixture evidence may authorize only structural claims. Wall-clock, provider, context-cost, or rework claims require actual execution evidence and are shadow-only in v0.11.
structural_vs_empirical_rule.old: Synthetic/fixture evidence may authorize only structural claims. Wall-clock, provider, context-cost, or rework claims require actual execution evidence and are shadow-only in v0.11.

inherited_metric_rows.new_numerator_rule: fixture count for which applying lifecycle transition rules to state+blockers exactly equals expected_next_action
inherited_metric_rows.old_numerator_rule: fixture count for which applying lifecycle transition rules to state+blockers exactly equals expected_next_action

inherited_metric_rows.new_numerator_rule: fixture count for which the independently recomputed set of all maximum-weight effective-DAG paths exactly equals expected.critical_paths
inherited_metric_rows.old_numerator_rule: fixture count for which the independently recomputed set of all maximum-weight effective-DAG paths exactly equals expected.critical_paths

inherited_metric_rows.new_numerator_rule: fixture count for which deterministic dependency+conflict-safe waves exactly equal expected.waves
inherited_metric_rows.old_numerator_rule: fixture count for which deterministic dependency+conflict-safe waves exactly equal expected.waves

inherited_metric_rows.new_numerator_rule: failure-injection fixtures satisfying all authored preservation and unrelated-rerun expectations
inherited_metric_rows.old_numerator_rule: failure-injection fixtures satisfying all authored preservation and unrelated-rerun expectations

inherited_metric_rows.new_numerator_rule: source-task keys covered by >=1 emitted workstream via tasks[*].source_task_ids where every covering emitted workstream has a schema-valid integration_contract; emitted workstreams with no source_task_ids are schema-invalid
inherited_metric_rows.old_numerator_rule: source-task keys covered by >=1 emitted workstream via tasks[*].source_task_ids where every covering emitted workstream has a schema-valid integration_contract; emitted workstreams with no source_task_ids are schema-invalid

inherited_metric_rows.new_numerator_rule: exact listed pytest node IDs with PASS outcome
inherited_metric_rows.old_numerator_rule: exact listed pytest node IDs with PASS outcome

inherited_metric_rows.new_numerator_rule: exact listed regression IDs with explicit passing verification evidence
inherited_metric_rows.old_numerator_rule: exact listed regression IDs with explicit passing verification evidence

inherited_metric_rows.new_numerator_rule: exact v0.10 manifest file entries whose path exists and sha256 equals manifest value
inherited_metric_rows.old_numerator_rule: exact v0.10 manifest file entries whose path exists and sha256 equals manifest value

independent_review_summary.retry_nonweakening_rule: The 15 v0.11 promotion-authoritative metrics are inherited without weaker targets; v0.11.1 adds prospective_output_classification_error_count == 0 and REG-0025.
